modules.name: Start here
modules.description:
# Welcome to DraconDex

This folder is a small working world. Everything in it is real data: open it, change it, delete it when you are done. Nothing here updates itself.

**One module = one job.** Each item in this folder is a module of a different kind. Open one to see what it is for.

- [[Characters]] — a category with fields. Every row is an object you can link to.
- [[Who knows whom]] — shows the characters and how they relate.
- [[Harbor map]] — a map with areas.
- [[History]] — a timeline of dated events.
- [[Travels]] — map pins tied to timeline events.
- [[The meeting]] — a branching conversation.
- [[Book one]] — chapters, a writing editor, and a corkboard.
- [[Session notes]] — chat-style notes.
- [[Rumors]] — a random table: press Roll.
- [[Harbor sketch]] — a freehand drawing page.
- [[Plot plan]] — a free diagram of boxes and arrows.
- [[About Mira]] — one page about one thing.

**Links.** Type `[[` anywhere to link to anything by name — like the links on this page. The thing you link to lists this page under its backlinks.

**Find anything.** Press Ctrl+P to find a module, an object, a line of text, or a command.

**Start your own.** Use + in the Nest, or "Start from template" for a whole project in one click.

modules.name: Characters
modules.description: A Classifier is a category: a list of objects that share fields. Click an object to open it; add a field with + under its fields. A field can be text, a number, a choice, a checkbox, a link to another object, or a formula.

objects.name: Mira
objects.note: Captain of the *Gull*. Owes [[Tobin]] a favor she has not mentioned.

objects.name: Tobin
objects.note: A scholar who reads old charts.

objects.name: Sela
objects.note: Knows every back door of the harbor.

modules.name: Who knows whom
modules.description: An Exhibitor shows other modules' content — here, the Characters. It owns nothing: deleting it loses only the layout. Try the Graph, Table and Board views, and the family-tree layout on the Friend field.

modules.name: Harbor map
modules.description: A Locator is a map. Add areas and points, and link them to anything in the Nexus.

modules.name: History
modules.description: A Chronicler is a timeline. Every event has a date; the calendar can be your world's own.

events.name: The storm year
events.story: [[Mira]] brings the *Gull* home through the storm.

events.name: The old charts are found
events.story: [[Tobin]] finds charts no one can read.

modules.name: Travels
modules.description: A Wanderer puts timeline events on a map, so you can see where things happened and in what order.

modules.name: The meeting
modules.description: A Narrator holds dialogues on a board. A dialogue can offer choices; a choice can depend on a story variable. The Reader view plays it through.

talks.speaker: Tobin
talks.text: The charts would not let me go.

talks.speaker: Sela
talks.text: If we sail tonight, nobody asks questions.

modules.name: Book one
modules.description: An Author module is a book: chapters on the left, the editor on the right. The Board view is a corkboard with each chapter's synopsis, status and point of view.

chapters.name: The dock
chapters.content: The tide turned before [[Tobin]] came down the dock.

chapters.name: The charts
chapters.synopsis: The charts show a coast no one knows.

modules.name: Session notes
modules.description: A Scribe is chat-style notes: quick lines with the time they were written. Good for a game session or a day's ideas.

sessions.name: First session
messages: The players met [[Sela]] at the fish market.
They agreed to sail at night.

modules.name: Rumors
modules.description: A Diviner rolls on random tables. A table can use dice (1d6) or weights, and a row can roll another table.

entries.text: A ship came in with no crew.
The lighthouse keeper has a guest.

modules.name: Harbor sketch
modules.description: A Sketcher is a freehand drawing board. A comic panel in a Designer can show one of its pages.

modules.name: Plot plan
modules.description: A Designer is a free diagram. Add shapes, connect them, and link a shape to anything.

modules.name: About Mira
modules.description: An Inspector is one page about one thing. This one is about [[Mira]]: write freely, with [[links]] like anywhere else.
